digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and dispatch
propositions: When a create crashes mid-flight on DC, a keyless-pending binding entry is created; a single negative JQL search for the rebar-id label (due to Lucene index lag) causes recover_pending to unbind, leaving get_jira_key returning None and unblocking a duplicate create in dispatch_one.create_one.

The duplicate is written at the create_one dedup site (dispatch_one.py:237-238), not at recover_pending; fixing recover_pending alone to leave the entry pending is insufficient because get_jira_key still returns None and the create gate does not consult is_pending().

The create gate must defer (not drop) creates when a keyless-pending binding for that local_id exists and is younger than an index-lag grace period; this requires a new accessor is_keyless_pending_within_grace consulted in create_one, not just absence of a jira_key.

Unbinding must require corroboration: search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeds the grace window (default 3600s), converting a silent duplicate into a delayed-but-correct binding once the index catches up.
recover_pending must not count a still-pending entry as resolved, and the keyed-pending branch (which performs no search) remains untouched and deterministic.
